news.title: Shamim Hossain joins Lumbini Lions
news.summary: Lumbini Lions announced Bangladesh all-rounder Shamim Hossain Patwary as an overseas signing for Season 3, according to Nepal News. No verified fee was reported, so the signing is excluded from domestic acquisition-cost analysis.

news.title: CAN sets Season 3 ticket prices
news.summary: CAN set league-stage admission at NPR 500 for general tickets and NPR 1,000 for premium tickets. For the Eliminator and Final, prices rise to NPR 1,000 general and NPR 2,000 premium, according to Onlinekhabar.

news.title: Sahibzada Farhan and Mohammad Saifuddin join Season 3 squads
news.summary: Karnali Yaks announced Pakistan batter Sahibzada Farhan, while Pokhara Avengers announced Bangladesh all-rounder Mohammad Saifuddin, according to Nepal News. No verified fees were reported, so both overseas signings are excluded from domestic acquisition-cost analysis.

news.title: Hussain Talat joins Karnali Yaks
news.summary: Karnali Yaks announced Pakistan all-rounder Hussain Talat as an overseas signing for Season 3, according to Nepal News. No verified fee was reported, so the signing is excluded from domestic acquisition-cost analysis.

news.title: Season 3 performances will count in official T20 statistics
news.summary: The ICC has recognised all Season 3 matches as official T20 fixtures, according to The Kathmandu Post. Runs, wickets and other performances from the October 26–November 21 tournament will therefore count in players’ official T20 records. This clarifies CAN’s October 21 announcement.

news.title: CAN revises Season 3 match start times
news.summary: Following the introduction of DRS, CAN revised the schedule so double-header days begin at 12:30 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. Nepal time, while single-match days begin at 5:00 p.m. Tournament dates and playoff milestones remain unchanged.

news.title: CAN confirms DRS for Season 3
news.summary: CAN announced that Season 3 will introduce the Decision Review System, according to The Kathmandu Post. The announced technology includes 3D ball tracking for LBW decisions and AI-based edge detection, with reviews also covering run-outs, stumpings and no-ball calls. This supersedes the earlier pending-decision status.

news.title: Chamika Karunaratne joins Pokhara Avengers
news.summary: Nepal News reports that Pokhara Avengers have signed Sri Lankan pace-bowling all-rounder Chamika Karunaratne for Season 3. The overseas signing is recorded as squad news only and does not enter domestic acquisition-cost comparisons.

news.title: Nepal Telecom signs Season 3 sponsorship agreement
news.summary: Nepal Telecom and CAN signed a sponsorship agreement for the third NPL season on October 18. Nepal Telecom managing director Sangita Pahadi and CAN general manager Utsav Dhungana signed the agreement. This league partnership does not establish any player acquisition price.

news.title: Andre Russell signs for Biratnagar Kings
news.summary: Biratnagar Kings announced West Indies all-rounder Andre Russell as a Season 3 signing on their social channels, according to The Kathmandu Post and Onlinekhabar. The reports do not disclose his fee, and the overseas signing is excluded from domestic cost analysis.

news.title: October 17: CAN outlines eligibility rules while DRS decision was pending
news.summary: CAN secretary Paras Khadka said overseas players, including retired internationals, need clearance from their home boards. The announced playing XI balance was seven Nepali and four overseas players, with ICC anti-corruption rules enforced. DRS was still pending at this briefing; CAN confirmed its introduction on October 20.

news.title: CAN confirms ICC sanction for Season 3
news.summary: CAN announced on October 16 that the ICC has approved the third Nepal Premier League, according to The Kathmandu Post. This resolves the previously pending sanction application. The reported tournament dates remain October 26–November 21; no historical statistics or player prices have been revised.

news.title: Biratnagar and Sudurpaschim prepare at training camps in India
news.summary: Onlinekhabar reports that Biratnagar Kings and Sudurpaschim Royals are training under floodlights in India ahead of Season 3. Biratnagar is at Purvanchal Cricket Academy in Uttar Pradesh, while Sudurpaschim is at Royal Sports Ganj Cricket Academy in Lucknow. Training reports are not forecasts of match performance.

news.title: Kevin O’Brien joins Season 3 broadcast team
news.summary: Former Ireland international Kevin O’Brien has joined Himalayan Sports as an expert analyst for its Season 3 coverage. This is a broadcast appointment and does not affect player cost or performance records.

news.title: Sudurpaschim unveils biodiversity-themed Api Edition kit
news.summary: Sudurpaschim Royals have unveiled an “Api Edition” jersey promoting the province’s natural heritage. The design highlights Api Mountain and features a Royal Bengal tiger associated with Shuklaphanta National Park.

news.title: Will Bosisto joins Kathmandu Gorkhas
news.summary: Kathmandu Gorkhas have signed Australian all-rounder Will Bosisto for Season 3 after his first two NPL seasons with Karnali Yaks. No verified fee has been published, so the overseas signing is excluded from domestic cost analysis.

news.title: Kirtipur stadium upgrades reported complete
news.summary: The Kathmandu Post reports that the TU International Cricket Ground upgrades are complete. Improvements include roughly 2,000 additional seats, a covered stand, an LED scoreboard, digital perimeter boards, upgraded dugouts and dining facilities, a media centre, family zone and improved toilets.

news.title: Season 3 mascots connect the league with Nepal
news.summary: Cricnepal’s guide identifies the eight franchise mascots and league mascot Jeet, linking the characters to Nepal’s wildlife, folklore, languages and regional identities. This is a cultural guide, not match-performance or cost evidence.

news.title: October 5: CAN was awaiting written ICC sanction
news.summary: On October 5, CAN secretary Paras Khadka said feedback on the Season 3 sanction application was positive but written approval was still pending. This historical status was superseded by CAN’s October 16 announcement confirming ICC sanction.

news.title: Moeen Ali signs for Janakpur Bolts
news.summary: Janakpur Bolts have signed former England all-rounder Moeen Ali for Season 3, according to reports published on October 3. No verified fee has been published, so the overseas signing is excluded from domestic cost analysis.

news.title: Lumbini and Sudurpaschim to open Season 3
news.summary: The reported schedule opens with Lumbini Lions against Sudurpaschim Royals on October 26. The final is scheduled for November 21.

news.title: Charith Asalanka joins Biratnagar Kings
news.summary: Cricnepal reports that Biratnagar announced Sri Lanka international Charith Asalanka through its official social channels. His signing adds a left-handed batting and off-spin option; match availability and selection are not guaranteed.

news.title: David Warner signs for Kathmandu Gorkhas
news.summary: Kathmandu announced David Warner in a player video shared by the franchise, according to The Kathmandu Post. No verified fee is included in this dataset, so the overseas signing does not enter domestic cost comparisons.

news.title: The next chapter has its dates
news.summary: Season 3 is scheduled for October 26–November 21. Follow the build-up here, alongside the evidence from the first two seasons.

news.title: Aasif Sheikh joins Lumbini for NPR 20 lakh
news.summary: Cricnepal reports Aasif Sheikh's Season 3 auction move from the released-player pool to Lumbini Lions for NPR 20 lakh. Onlinekhabar separately reports the same price. This is an acquisition price; Season 3 cost efficiency awaits recorded match performance.

news.title: 52 players retained ahead of the new season
news.summary: Retention decisions shape the next campaign. Historical team associations on this site should not be read as confirmed Season 3 squads.
